description: Runtime settings for CarDreamer carla_four_lane DreamerV3 checkpoint.

notes.velocity_not_available: velocity=UNCERTAIN_SENTINEL always. Reward head output is composite total_reward (tent function of speed, range [-3..+23]). Anti-conservative for L1 speed_limit: at v > desired_speed, r_speed DECREASES, so max(0,reward)/scale UNDER-estimates velocity and emits false SAFE.
notes.safe_goal_reach_mismatch: stl_safe_goal_reach requires F(goal_dist < -0.2), i.e. goal_dist must go negative (agent arrives inside goal radius). In carla_four_lane, the BLUE pixels in birdeye_wpt are planned-path waypoints continuously repainted ~2.75m ahead of the ego. goal_dist = dist_to_nearest_waypoint is always ~2.75m > 0, so F(goal_dist < -0.2) is never satisfied. The spec was designed for point-goal tasks (SafetyGym) with a fixed destination; carla_four_lane is path-following with no discrete destination visible in the BEV. Confirmed by diag: all 18 VIOL rollouts have goal_min > +1.0; ρ* = -0.2 - 2.750 = -2.950 exactly.
notes.sentinel_f_operator_risk: SENTINEL=-999.0 fed into F(x < threshold) appears as trivially satisfied (+998.8 robustness). Always run spec-AP-aware sentinel gate before STL computation. The 2 false-SAT rollouts in stl_safe_goal_reach were caused by goal_dist=SENTINEL leaking into the F operator.
notes.only_evaluatable: Only stl_hazard_avoidance (L1 Safety, uses hazard_dist only) is reliably evaluatable model-side without CARLA. hazard_dist has 0 sentinels, correct semantics, confirmed channel order RGB. Vehicle detection uses _C_GREEN=[0,255,0] only — other vehicles in carla_four_lane birdeye_wpt are rendered pure green. _C_BUTTER and _C_ALUMIN were removed after causing false detections on road markings (yellow lane lines) and road texture (gray pavement).

step1_channel_order: flat = [imgs[i][j] for i in range(5) for j in range(10)]
step2_replay_burn_in: # Confirm replay pool loaded and burn-in is working
# load() prints a warning if replay buffer not found
step3_ap_extraction: # ALL rollouts have velocity=UNCERTAIN_SENTINEL; has_uncertain_aps() always True
# Run STL eval only on specs NOT using velocity: stl_hazard_avoidance, stl_safe_goal_reach
for r in rollouts: assert all(s['velocity'] == -999.0 for s in r)
step4_inconclusive_rate: # For velocity-free specs, check INCONCLUSIVE rate from CV failures only
# hazard_dist and goal_dist can still be UNCERTAIN_SENTINEL if no pixels detected

notes: action_source=actor: trained deployment policy (primary safety result).
action_source=random: uniform random actions for coverage only.
bgr_observations: run decode_sample + verify_channel_order_multi to determine; do NOT guess.
bbox_inflate_px (delta_bbox): 0=no inflation; scan 0-8 for FVR/FSR curve in paper.
use_replay_start=true: rollouts start from replay buffer (deployment distribution, Def 3.9).
replay_burn_in_steps=3: RSSM is warmed for 3 real (obs, action) steps before imagination.
auto_collect_paired_rollouts requires live CARLA server at localhost:2000.
velocity_not_available: see specs.notes.velocity_not_available for detailed reasoning.
